title: Global Nonexistence of Twisted Bridges in F_2-Magnus Quotients and Six-Conjugate Primitive Exclusion for Andrews-Curtis Candidates
decided_scope: Unrestricted nonexistence of the P_2 and P_0 twisted conjugacy bridge equations in degree-4 and degree-5 F_2-Magnus quotients, all-Aut(F_2) two-element conjugate-join primitive exclusion, and six-conjugate primitive exclusion w_prim(H) >= 7
open_boundaries: Full Andrews-Curtis trivializability of AK(3) and MS_14
